functions.title: Regulation of Passenger Transport
functions.body: Passenger transport is a power vested in the Provincial Council since 1987, with provisions under Act No. 1 of 1994 for the establishment of this Authority.

functions.title: Increasing Passenger Safety
functions.body: Providing security for passengers travelling in the province, subject to NTC regulations, provincial statutes and rules of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council.

functions.title: Quality Passenger Transport
functions.body: Improving in-bus service, running training programmes for drivers and conductors, and shaping the attitudes of employees toward the travelling public.

functions.title: Employee Welfare
functions.body: Introducing welfare programmes for staff and maintaining funds for charity work across the province.

about.title: About the Authority
about.subtitle: Board of Directors, history, mandate and statistics.
about.p1: The Sabaragamuwa Provincial Road Passenger Transport Authority was established by the relevant charter under Act No. 1 of 1994, following the vesting of passenger-transport powers in the Provincial Council in 1987.
about.p2: The institute operates under the Chief Ministry of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council and serves passengers, bus owners, drivers, conductors and staff of the transport authority. The Head Office is in Ratnapura and the District Office is in Kegalle.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Effective, efficient service driven by results-based management, public relations and team spirit.

rti.title: Right to Information
rti.subtitle: Transparency of public institutions maintained by the tax monies of the people.
rti.heading: Right to Information Act
rti.p1: With the establishment of republic states, a concept which denotes that the ownership of the state lies with the people was evolved. State and public institutions are maintained by the tax monies of the people — the fundamental principle being that the people have the right to know how the functions of the state are accomplished using public funds.
